independence_note: The v0.45 module rewrote the plan representation, purity test, response-partition construction, canonicalisation, dynamic program, memoisation, expansion accounting and expected-elimination greedy comparator. It imported no v0.44 planner, prior plan type or prior quotient helper. It reused only frozen dataset loaders, the task interface and the preregistered state harvester.
scientific_note: A separately implemented solver reproduced all 65 v0.44 state-level exact plans, greedy plans, query savings and exact expansion counts, as well as all aggregate results. This removes the most direct single-implementation explanation for the v0.44 result.
